name: Contact Data Extractor
purpose: Extract structured contact and company information from unstructured text such as email signatures, LinkedIn profiles, website copy, or scraped business pages. Identify and return: full name, job title, company name, email address, phone number, website URL, city/region, and industry. If a field is not found, return null for that field. Output as a clean JSON object. Do not invent or guess values — only extract what is explicitly present in the input.
